verdict.rationale: Firebase Cloud Functions can be triggered by Cloud Scheduler jobs, enabling recurring/scheduled workflows, per official docs. However this relies on an external GCP service (Cloud Scheduler) rather than a native Firebase scheduling primitive, and a community report specifically calls out the historical absence of built-in scheduled tasks on Firebase, forcing users toward alternatives like AWS Lambda scheduled events. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party tutorial/example for setting up scheduled Cloud Functions, independent hands-on confirmation of ease-of-use, and evidence the gap noted by long-time users has been fully resolved beyond a single doc line.
